newsitem.title: USA: Portland General Electric to cut rates 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Portland General Electric to cut rates 7 pct.

text.p: Portland General Electric Co said it reached an agreement with the Oregon Public Utility Commission and the Citizen's Utility Board for an overall seven percent decrease in electricity rates.
The agreement includes $55 million in annual revenue reductions, in addition to the $15 million in revenue reductions previously approved.
The company said average residential electricity bills will drop by close to $4.50 a month, or about $54 a year as a result of the new agreement.
